 CRGY: Strong Q3 cash flow and Permian synergies support acquisition-led growth and rapid deleveraging
 Less than 1 min read CRGY Q3 adjusted EBITDAX reached $786 MM and levered FCF was $367 MM, 23% above consensus, on 328 Mboe/d production and lower-than-estimated capex. Permian synergies and the pending Devon Eagle Ford acquisition underpin further growth and deleveraging targets. 
 Original document: Crescent Energy Company [CRGY] Slides Release — Nov. 3 2026
